preference.response: Global, storage.local (proposed) — Persist only {enabled: boolean} in chrome.storage.local; a missing key means true. The current tab must acknowledge cleanup/reconciliation; other runnable tabs converge via storage.onChanged; frozen tabs re-read on resume. Survives browser restart in both states. Delivery is asynchronous — no promise of atomic application across frozen tabs.
